summary: Costa Rica’s pledges combine conservation, restoration, agriculture and integrated action. Conservation aims at a 60% forest-cover target and zero mature-forest deforestation by 2030, 30% ocean protection by 2022, and 100% protection of inventoried coastal wetlands by 2025. Agriculture targets 69,500 ha of silvopastoral and agroforestry systems by 2030, 70% of the cattle herd and 60% of livestock area under low-emission systems, 50% of coffee-growing area under sustainable production, and a 1% annual pasture reduction with 1–2% annual growth in well-managed pasture. Restoration includes an additional 30,000 ha of urban forest landscapes, 2,000 ha of mangroves, 600 ha at prioritized sites, and 80% of restoration-eligible Gulf of Nicoya mangroves. Integrated action will intervene across 1,000,000 ha of forest landscapes by 2030—about 26.8% of the 37,354 km² currently mapped as forest—and manage 25,000 ha of secondary forest, while restoring and conserving 10,000 ha of recharge zones and riparian corridors.
